pieces.start: Rasikānanda He was a Vaiṣṇava poet.
pieces.title: Rasikānanda, Vaiṣṇava poet (was in the record of Rasikamohana Vidyābhūṣaṇa)

fields.notes: A Vaiṣṇava poet; pada 2227 of the Padakalpataru, on Lord Gaurāṅga's acceptance of sannyāsa, is his. Perhaps Rasikānanda Prabhu (#1908); the record does not say. Taken out of the record of Rasikamohana Vidyābhūṣaṇa #1303 (11-11-2026).
